package gooo_workspace
namespace gooo_workspace

entity AssemblyObservation id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation" fields {
    field matched id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/matched" type integer required one
    field total id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/total" type integer required one
    field best id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/best" type integer required one
    field scored id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/scored" type integer required one
    field budget id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/budget" type integer required one
}
entity Explanation id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation" fields {
    field state id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation/state" type string required one
    field next_operation id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation/next-operation" type string required one
    field message id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation/message" type string required one
}
entity Boolean id "gooo://tools/boolean"
activity GoooPackage0ActivityCanContinue(AssemblyObservation) -> Boolean computes "return input.scored < input.budget"
activity GoooPackage1ActivityExplain(AssemblyObservation) -> Explanation computes "if input.matched < 0 || input.total < 0 || input.best < input.matched || input.best > input.total || input.scored < 0 || input.budget < input.scored {\n    return Explanation{state: \"FAIL_CLOSED\", next_operation: \"RECONCILE_COUNTS\", message: \"관측 수치의 범위를 확인하세요.\"}\n}\nif input.total == 0 {\n    return Explanation{state: \"UNKNOWN\", next_operation: \"DECLARE_CASES\", message: \"판단할 사례가 선언되지 않았습니다.\"}\n}\nif input.scored == 0 {\n    return Explanation{state: \"UNKNOWN\", next_operation: \"EVALUATE_CANDIDATES\", message: \"후보를 아직 채점하지 않았습니다.\"}\n}\nif input.best > input.matched {\n    return Explanation{state: \"PROGRESS\", next_operation: \"USE_OBSERVED_CANDIDATE\", message: \"더 많은 사례를 만족한 후보가 기록되어 있습니다.\"}\n}\nif input.matched == input.total {\n    return Explanation{state: \"PASS\", next_operation: \"OBSERVE_NEW_INPUTS\", message: \"선언한 사례를 만족했습니다. 새 입력은 별도로 관측하세요.\"}\n}\nif GoooPackage0ActivityCanContinue(input) {\n    return Explanation{state: \"PROGRESS\", next_operation: \"CONTINUE_CANDIDATES\", message: \"남은 예산에서 다른 후보를 관측할 수 있습니다.\"}\n}\nreturn Explanation{state: \"PROGRESS\", next_operation: \"EXPAND_DECLARED_CHOICES\", message: \"현재 후보와 예산에서 만족하지 못한 사례가 남았습니다.\"}"
